## Weekly GitHub Dev Summary → Claude → Slack
Every Friday 5pm this pulls the week's commits, merged PRs and closed issues for a repo, asks Claude (claude-sonnet-4-20250514) to write a narrative summary (EN or FR), and posts it to Slack/Discord.

Config in the **Config** node. Secrets via env: GITHUB_TOKEN, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (x-api-key credential), SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL.

Built by myn8n-automation.org
